ops.title: Leave WordNet to Captain Hook's first use
ops.description: A fresh Sprite create spends 22.7 s preparing WordNet before it publishes. Owner ruling 2026-10-10: most sessions never need WordNet, so initialise it on first use. Remove the create-time prewarm and its pool-key contract.

ops.text: A create with a Captain Hook inventory runs no WordNet phase, and CI is green
On a fresh Sprite built from the release, a first concurrent use initialises ~/.wn_data/wn.db once and it passes PRAGMA quick_check
